Samsung also says it uses new optical technologies to improve colour accuracy and image clarity while supporting RAW16 output, Super QPD autofocus and burst shooting at multiple resolutions. The ISOCELL HPC is already in mass production.
title: Samsung 200MP ISOCELL HPC Camera Sensor Announced With Better HDR and Low-Light Performance

description: Google is expected to introduce the HiLight feature during the Made by Google event on August 12. Ahead of the event, 9to5Google has spotted new details about the HiLight feature, which is expected to be introduced with the upcoming Google Pixel 11 series, in the code strings of Google Contacts for Android. According to the report, the HiLight feature, codenamed “glow”, will let users configure and assign a glow colour to specific contacts. The HiLight feature will light up in that particular colour when that specific person calls the user.
title: Google Pixel 11 Series HiLight Feature to Reportedly Support Multiple Colours; Might Let Users Assign Colours to Callers

description: Samsung has revealed new details about customer demand for its latest foldable smartphones through a report shared with the media. The Galaxy Z Fold 8 series has achieved record pre order figures, while more Galaxy Z Flip users have upgraded to the Fold lineup than in previous years. Samsung also disclosed the most popular colour options, Galaxy Watch attachment rates and expectations for future growth in the foldable smartphone segment, which it expects to expand significantly over the next few years.
title: Samsung Says More Galaxy Z Flip Users Are Upgrading to Galaxy Z Fold 8

description: Xiaomi has introduced Mijia, its new sub-brand, in India, commemorating 12 years of its presence in the country. The new sub-brand joins Redmi and Poco, while Xiaomi retains its flagship positioning. Xiaomi plans to sell smart home and heavy appliances under the Mijia brand name. The new products will sell alongside the devices from Redmi and Poco, the other two sub-brands from the company. Meanwhile, Xiaomi will retain the flagship status among the house of Xiaomi brands. The first product to launch in India under the Mijia branding will be an air purifier.

description: A Samsung wearable internally codenamed Galaxy Aero is said to be in the works. The reference to this model was reportedly spotted in Samsung's Galaxy Wearable app. It is mentioned as “galaxy_rtos_watch", indicating a real-time operating system (RTOS), which is used in other affordable wearables. This Galaxy Aero is expected to sit between the Galaxy Fit 4 and Galaxy Watch FE.
title: Samsung Galaxy Aero Reportedly Spotted in Galaxy Wearable App Code, May Launch Soon

description: Redmi K100 Pro Max will be equipped with a 6.9-inch RGB OLED display, which might offer M11 luminescent material, up to 185Hz refresh rate, 90 percent BT.2020 resolution, and up to 4,500 nits peak brightness with 25 percent performance, according to a tipster. description: Assassin's Creed's leadership team has a new member. Eric Baptizat, who served as game director on Assassin’s Creed Valhalla and lead game designer on Assassin's Creed Origins and Black Flag, is returning to Ubisoft. Baptizat will join Guesdon, Martin Schelling, and François de Billy as part of the leadership team in charge of the Assassin's Creed franchise at Vantage Studios.
title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla Director Returns to Ubisoft as Game Director for Assassin's Creed Brand

description: The JBL Live 780NC packs in nearly every feature you'd expect from a premium pair of wireless headphones, but it's the overall experience that stands out. After two weeks of daily use, the comfortable fit, dependable ANC, excellent battery life and highly customisable companion app made it easy to keep coming back to. The default tuning benefits from a little EQ tweaking, but once dialled in, the headphones deliver an enjoyable listening experience across music, movies, gaming and everyday work without missing a beat.
title: JBL Live 780NC Review: The Complete Package?

description: Google on Thursday announced a fresh set of updates for Ask Maps. The new features expand upon the capabilities of the Gemini-powered natural language query tool, which was first introduced in Maps in March. Calling it the biggest overhaul to Google Maps in over a decade, Ask Maps can now respond to users in Hindi, receive real-time public transit information, and use Personal Intelligence for more personalised recommendations. Google claims to also remember previous conversations, which allows users to continue planning trips without starting afresh.
title: Google Updates Ask Maps Feature With Hindi Support, Real-Time Transit Updates in India
